depth_task_pair_exact: Qwen 3 and Gemma 4 baseline-correct to adapter-wrong flips. No gains in either; both adapters were 36/36 content-parse valid globally.

scorer.definition: Exact normalized displayed-value / label match with explicit natural EOS and no cap, all36 retained. Strict FINAL and parse validity are separate measurements.

train_only_criterion.motivation: Both adapters lose previously correct endpoint-difference cases while both improve maximum-depth identification. Sign balancing is a training design choice, with no inferred sign-specific failure.
train_only_criterion.name: Sign-balanced displayed-depth difference
train_only_criterion.rule: Use distinct train-only source charts to form 1:1 pairs of strictly positive and strictly negative depth_change examples. Compute the sign from the same two fixed endpoint values after their displayed rounding; independently recompute the signed two-decimal result. If either sign is unavailable for pairing, stop at the smaller qualified count. Deduplicate charts and exclude all development and independent final-blind source IDs, chart hashes and event closure groups before sampling.
train_only_criterion.split_policy: Dev36 stays frozen development only; the final blind stays independent and sealed. Split disjointness is verified by the data owner against identity manifests without exposing final blind content.
